Iqiyi Inc – American Depositary Shares (NASDAQ:IQ) Just Reported Increased Shorts Posted by Darrin Black 37 pm
The stock of Iqiyi Inc – American Depositary Shares (NASDAQ:IQ) registered an increase of 1.54% in short interest. IQ’s total short interest was 44.86M shares in December as published by FINRA. Its up 1.54% from 44.18 million shares, reported previously. With 8.10M shares average volume, it will take short sellers 6 days to cover their IQ’s short positions. The short interest to Iqiyi Inc – American Depositary Shares’s float is 22.03%.
The stock decreased 3.28% or $0.6 during the last trading session, reaching $17.7. About 7.10 million shares traded. iQIYI, Inc. (NASDAQ:IQ) has 0.00% . It has by 0.00% the S&P500.
iQIYI, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides online entertainment services under the iQIYI brand name in China. The company has market cap of $12.81 billion. The firm operates a platform that provides a collection of Internet video content, including professionally-produced content licensed from professional content providers and self-produced content. It has a 16.7 P/E ratio. It provides membership, content distribution, live broadcasting, and online gaming services.
